narrative: On the tables. The tables have not grown. The bundle is still at the far side of the board. Grey light, no candle. On the tables. One word started under the fourth line, then rubbed while the wax is still soft. The word is gone. The four lines remain. On the tables. A pale oval where the word was. He does not write into it. The knot has not moved.
